title: Strict read-only checker accepts a `\&` escaped outside quotes; unexamined for non-bash executors (Kimi)
outcome: Decide and enforce the strict read-only command checker's verdict for separators escaped outside quotes (for example `grep a\&\&b f`) for callers whose executor shell is not proven to be bash. Kimi's read-only gate (kimi_read_only.rs:418) and engram_command_reads_only run the strict path, and Kimi's Windows shell is undocumented. Either prove the strict callers' executors treat `\&` as escaped, or make the strict path refuse it, with the semantics change for Kimi and Engram stated and reviewed.
acceptance: Strict read-only checker accepts a `\&` escaped outside quotes; unexamined for non-bash executors (Kimi) is done
